gold: IBD-associated neutrophilic dermatosis with ulcerative colitis

selector.rationale: The presence of facial crusted plaques, well-demarcated vegetative crusted plaques, and intradermal neutrophilic inflammation with ulceration and intracorneal neutrophils strongly supports Sweet syndrome, while the history of diverticulosis and colonic polyps and bloody and watery diarrhea suggests a possible association with inflammatory bowel disease.

rejected.label: Erythema nodosum
rejected.why: The presence of facial crusted plaques contradicts the typical presentation of erythema nodosum, which usually involves lower extremity nodules without facial involvement.

rejected.label: Pyoderma gangrenosum
rejected.why: The biopsy findings of intradermal neutrophilic inflammation with ulceration and intracorneal neutrophils do not support pyoderma gangrenosum, which typically shows ulceration and necrosis.

rejected.label: Neutrophilic panniculitis
rejected.why: While the biopsy of the right thigh showed septal panniculitis with Miescher radial granulomas, the facial crusted plaques and intradermal neutrophilic inflammation are more characteristic of Sweet syndrome.
